invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object as it returns the result of an execute() method which is expected to produce a write metadata instance.
A non-null context is required for method execution, as it is cast and passed along.
The instantTime parameter is passed through and likely necessary for meaningful execution.
preppedRecords is used and passed on to the executor, implying it should not be null at method exit.
bulkInsertPartitioner is passed unconditionally to the executor, suggesting it should not be null (Option may be empty but not null).
